instruction: How to create a Crossplane GCP CloudSQL instance
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: sql.gcp.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: DatabaseInstance
metadata:
  name: my-cloudsql
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-central1
    databaseVersion: POSTGRES_14
    settings:
      tier: db-custom-1-3840
      diskSize: 20
    deletionProtection: false
  providerConfigRef:
    name: gcp-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane GCP storage bucket
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: storage.gcp.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: my-gcp-bucket
spec:
  forProvider:
    location: US-EAST1
    storageClass: STANDARD
    uniformBucketLevelAccess: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: gcp-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane GCP IAM service account
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: iam.gcp.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: my-sa
spec:
  forProvider:
    displayName: My Service Account
  providerConfigRef:
    name: gcp-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Azure resource group
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: azure.crossplane.io/v1alpha3
kind: ResourceGroup
metadata:
  name: my-resource-group
spec:
  location: East US
  providerConfigRef:
    name: azure-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Azure storage account
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: storage.azure.crossplane.io/v1alpha3
kind: Account
metadata:
  name: mystorageaccount
spec:
  forProvider:
    resourceGroupNameRef:
      name: my-resource-group
    location: East US
    kind: StorageV2
    sku:
      name: Standard_LRS
  providerConfigRef:
    name: azure-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Azure SQL server
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: sql.azure.crossplane.io/v1alpha3
kind: Server
metadata:
  name: my-sqlserver
spec:
  forProvider:
    resourceGroupNameRef:
      name: my-resource-group
    location: East US
    version: "12.0"
    administratorLogin: admin
    administratorLoginPasswordSecretRef:
      name: sql-admin-pass
      namespace: default
      key: password
  providerConfigRef:
    name: azure-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Azure AKS cluster
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: containerservice.azure.crossplane.io/v1alpha3
kind: AKSCluster
metadata:
  name: my-aks
spec:
  forProvider:
    resourceGroupNameRef:
      name: my-resource-group
    location: East US
    dnsNamePrefix: myaks
    agentPoolProfiles:
    - name: agentpool
      count: 2
      vmSize: Standard_B2s
  providerConfigRef:
    name: azure-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane custom controller config with resource limits
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
kind: ControllerConfig
metadata:
  name: my-custom-config
spec:
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 1
      memory: 1Gi'
